en: Air is a mixture of gases that has measurable mass and takes up space, which is why an inflated balloon is heavier than an empty one.
When sugar dissolves in water, it breaks into invisible particles, but the total mass of the sweet solution remains exactly the same as the original ingredients.
Not all metals are magnetic; for example, aluminum cans and copper wires are metals that will not be attracted to a standard magnet.
While actively boiling at sea level, liquid water stays at exactly 100 degrees Celsius and does not get hotter until it completely turns into steam.
Rusting is a chemical change because iron reacts with oxygen and moisture to form a completely new, brittle substance called iron oxide.
Objects cool down because thermal energy flows out of them into their cooler surroundings, rather than coldness flowing into the objects.
The visible white cloud above boiling water is actually tiny liquid water droplets, because true water vapor is an invisible gas.
Crushing a solid rock into smaller sand particles is only a physical change because the chemical composition of the minerals remains completely unchanged.
You can physically separate a mixture of salt and sand by adding water to dissolve the salt, then filtering and evaporating the liquid.
Burning wood is a chemical change because the heat causes it to react with oxygen, producing entirely new substances like ash and carbon dioxide.
While liquids take the shape of their container, they always maintain a definite volume that does not expand or shrink just by changing containers.
Evaporation is a physical change because liquid water turning into water vapor only changes the spacing of the molecules, not their chemical structure.
